result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. I didn't run any tests after the final javadoc edit. The `mvn -q -o test` run in my last command printed nothing, which normally means a clean pass, but I didn't check the exit code. I also didn't add a test for the Anna/Bob example.

In `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` I added an `ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry to `CustomerAttributedRecords`. It's the same as `PURCHASE_ORDERS` plus `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` now uses it, and I updated its javadoc. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I left the existing `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry as it was, because the per-country purchase-order count also uses it and you only asked about the per-rep report. If you want the per-country count to skip cancelled orders too, it's a one-line change.
